title: Clam Digging With a Sigh
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Haibara, Agasa, Detective Boys) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file's culprit (s2 = Shoko Hisazu) and mechanism (poisoned cap swap, staged suicide via a planted jar) both check out against the full transcript -- no correction needed there. What the old file missed entirely: the unnamed hit-and-run victim from the backstory car accident (the actual root of the motive), Inspector Yokomizo's younger brother (the on-scene investigating officer who nearly closes the case as suicide and performs the luminol test), the original blood-stained cap as a separate physical object from the swapped poisoned cap, and the specific comparative clues (blood amount mismatch, missing sixth cap, Hisazu's premature knowledge of the blood) that actually prove the swap -- the old file's single clue node collapsed all of this into one generic line. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Heavy blood on the bottle's mouth vs. only a trace on the recovered cap -- inconsistent for one and the same original cap, implying a swap.
Six plastic bottles recovered from the group's trash but only five caps -- the missing sixth cap is the discarded original.
Hisazu named Ushigome's finger injury the instant blood on the bottle mouth was mentioned, before anyone had disclosed why -- she'd seen the bloodied original cap firsthand while swapping it.
